differences.openwhisper: The AI insights switch starts at meeting_cloud_last_enabled; the consent dialog is asked once, meeting_cloud_consent_given then lets later meetings send text without asking, and the dialog names the chosen backup agent in the same consent.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: The switch starts off for every meeting. Turning it on for a meeting (at its start or live) shows the consent naming that meeting's destination, and the grant covers that route only; nothing stored lets a later meeting send text without asking. The backup agent is named in the consent and authorized by its own dialog for its own route.
differences.reason: Installed agents and hosted models are destinations the user must have named to them before transcript text leaves the machine, every time.
differences.source: tests/meeting/test_runtime_consent.cpp; tests/ui_meeting/test_meeting_presenter.cpp ('Meeting Mode starts and ends through the desktop presenter': a fresh live enable asks even when the grant store remembers the route); src/ui_meeting/meeting_presenter.cpp (buildTab, askIntelligenceConsent, askBackupConsent)

differences.openwhisper: With Fast judgments on and a remote judge (TypeSafe, OpenRouter or a hosted text model), the consent dialog says short transcript excerpts also go to that judge, and the tab's line for a local model reads 'the model runs on this computer' instead of 'transcript text stays on this computer'.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: Meetings use only a Fast judgments judge on this computer (local_fast_judge: the live topic judge, insight review and semantic search), so no judge is named in the consent and the local line keeps 'transcript text stays on this computer'.
differences.reason: A hosted judge never receives meeting excerpts in OpenWhisper_CPP, so naming it would be untrue.
differences.source: src/ui_meeting/meeting_feature.cpp (deps.local_fast_judge returns a judge only for a local route); src/meeting/detail/live_intelligence.cpp (topic_judge uses only a local judge); docs/port/differences.md (review and semantic search only with local_fast_judge); tests/ui_meeting/test_ai_insights_copy.cpp ('test_local_fast_judgments_keep_the_privacy_claim', 'the consent names a local endpoint and says the text stays')

differences.openwhisper: Choosing OpenAI for speaker identification in Settings shows MeetingAudioConsentDialog ('Upload system audio for speaker identification'); after it the system-audio recording is uploaded automatically after each meeting.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: The OpenAI speaker pass runs only from Past Meetings' explicit 'Identify speakers with OpenAI' action, which asks each time, names the meeting and says what is sent (the system-audio track) and what stays (microphone track, transcript, names), with Cancel as the default.
differences.reason: Meeting audio leaves the computer only on an action the user takes for that meeting.
differences.source: tests/meeting/test_cloud_speakers.cpp; tests/ui_meeting/test_meeting_readiness.cpp ('the explicit speaker pass names what is sent to OpenAI and defaults to Cancel'); src/ui_meeting/meeting_presenter.cpp identifySavedSpeakers

differences.openwhisper: Open meetings folder creates the folder with os.makedirs; when that fails, the exception leaves the Qt slot unhandled and the folder is not opened.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: A meetings folder that cannot be created is logged as 'Could not create the meetings folder <path>: <reason>' and nothing is opened; the user is shown no message.
differences.reason: A failure must not escape a Qt slot in C++. Whether the user should also see a message is left to the owner (docs/port/open-items.md, Waiting on the owner).
